_comment: Example MCP client config for the v1-v6 governance server. Copy the block(s) you need into your Claude Desktop claude_desktop_config.json (mcpServers). TWO modes are shown: (1) a LOCAL stdio launch that runs the OPEN BASELINE on this machine, and (2) a REMOTE/HOSTED URL that connects to the operator's infra where the closed _premium moat overlay is installed server-side. Use ONE of them, not both, unless you intentionally want both registered.

quantchoai-governance-local._comment: LOCAL stdio. Runs the server as a child process on this machine. Open baseline unless quant.governance._premium is installed here. 'cwd' MUST be the repo's backend/ dir so 'quant.governance' is importable. Requires: pip install mcp.

quantchoai-governance-hosted._comment: REMOTE/HOSTED. Connects to the operator-hosted endpoint (run with QCHO_MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http behind the operator's auth/proxy). The hosted infra ships the closed _premium overlay, so this gives the FULL moat decision while the moat code never reaches the client. Replace the URL + token with your deployment's values.
